cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep Friday free in case I need moving help. A sensible plan includes contingency time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already promised Alex I'd paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then specify when you're available. Could you answer your phone before you open the paint?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. A precise plan comes before packing. Alex has an afternoon; I have the interval before he opens a tin.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asserts proper contingency planning, A3 demands precise availability and A5 corrects preparation order while judging B priority without admitting a test.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 real commitment prompts A3 smaller phone favour; B4 flat question prompts A5 no-flat admission and an offended comparison of time allocations.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers contact and reasonably checks whether a move exists, giving B an independent practical position.

heightening.evidence: A5 reveals A manufactured contingency and judges an accepted small favour as inadequate loyalty.

specificity.evidence: A1 Friday move possibility and B2 paint session explain the time comparison; no actual move is falsely established.
